newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close flat ahead of market holiday.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close flat ahead of market holiday.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed broadly flat in slow trade ahead of Monday's Corpus Christi market holiday, traders said.
But share prices are still well supported and gains are seen for next week when trading is expected to pick up again.
"The session may have been slow, but there's still good interest in Venezuela," said Activalores broker Carlos Sanchez.
The bolsa's 19-share .IBC index closed down a hair at 6,855.41 points as 74 million shares exchanged hands, worth five billion bolivars ($10 million).
"That's the kind of activity you would expect ahead of a holiday," said another broker.
Among traded issues, 17 rose, 13 fell and 13 closed flat.
